entities.name: Skithiryx
entities.description: A compleated Furnace Dragon from Mirrodin, a skeletal undead Phyrexian abomination responsible for mass abductions in the Oxidda Chain.

entities.name: Novosh
entities.description: A Mirran barbarian dispatched to kill a dragon who was killed by Skithiryx's oil tears and heard the whispers.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian figure with whom Skithiryx seems to have a connection.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Mountain region on Mirrodin where abductions occurred.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane of Skithiryx and Novosh.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Rising faction whose dragon Skithiryx became.

events.summary: Novosh climbs to where the dragon last struck, sent to kill it.
events.quote: Novosh had been dispatched to kill a dragon.

events.summary: Skithiryx seizes Novosh in its claw and asks if he hears her whispering.
events.quote: Novosh felt panic as he was lifted into the air

events.summary: Skithiryx's black oil tears are inhaled by Novosh, who then hears the whispers.
Skithiryx fights in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Skithiryx fought in the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.quote: He seems to have some connection to Sheoldred .
